title: SG-8.2.2 Max-length constant, counter and over-limit block
summary: Contribution textarea enforces a maximum length with a visible n / max counter and an inline over-limit message
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) already blocks blank submits but has no maximum length. The backend rejects prompts over cfg.Contribution.MaxPromptLen (default 500, counted with utf8.RuneCountInString on the trimmed prompt). Desired behavior: a shared max-length constant, a visible 'n / max' counter, an inline over-limit message, and submit blocked while over the limit. Expected result: players see the limit before the backend rejects them. Why: avoids a wasted round trip and a generic 'Could not send' error.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open, When the player types text, Then a counter reads 'n / 500' where n is the character count of the trimmed text
Given the text is longer than the maximum, When the player looks at the form, Then an inline over-limit message is visible and the textarea is marked invalid
Given the text is over the limit, When the player clicks Send, Then submitContribution is not called
Given the text is within the limit, When the player clicks Send, Then submitContribution is called as before

in_scope: Max-length constant in the API client module
Counter and over-limit message in ContributionSheet
Submit blocked while over the limit

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript only; no new dependencies
Constant value must match the backend default of 500
Count Unicode characters of the trimmed text, as the backend does
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered and their unit tests pass
non_functional: Counter and message are exposed to assistive tech via aria-describedby
